projects.title: SaaS Analytics Dashboard
projects.shortDesc: A full-stack real-time analytics web dashboard with dark blue theme, interactive charts, and user management.
projects.description: A modern SaaS application designed for enterprise analytics. Features live data visualization using Recharts, dark glassmorphism UI layout, custom export options, and complete user role control built with React, Laravel, and Tailwind CSS.

experiences.description: Developed and optimized enterprise web application features, internal banking portals, and RESTful APIs for PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BCA). Collaborated with senior IT engineers in agile sprints to ensure high security, low latency, and smooth user experience.
